Preconditions

  2. Press Tab until something on the board shows a focus ring.

  4. Press the Down arrow key.
  5. Press Tab.
  6. Press Tab again.
  7. Click "Tech View" in the display switcher.
  8. Click once in the "Search" box.
  9. Press Tab until something in the table shows a focus ring.
  10. Press the Down arrow key.

Step 1: the cursor is in the "Search" box and nothing on the board has a focus ring.

Step 2: the focus ring lands on a card, the first one on the board (unit "C97021-U4" in "Unassigned"). No column header gets the focus ring on the way.

Step 4: focus moves down to the next item in the same column, a card of "ZZAUTOTEST C97021 Ana".

Step 5: focus moves to the focused card's own "More actions" (…) button, not to another card.

Step 6: focus leaves the board; no other card or column header gets the focus ring.

Step 7: Tech View shows the "Unassigned" group first, then "ZZAUTOTEST C97021 Ana" and "ZZAUTOTEST C97021 Ben".

Step 8: the cursor is in the "Search" box and nothing in the table has a focus ring.

Step 9: the focus ring lands on a work order row, the first one (unit "C97021-U4" in "Unassigned"), not on a group header.

Step 10: focus moves to the next item below, the group header of "ZZAUTOTEST C97021 Ana".

N3-S2R23-tooltips.title: Density and Columns tooltips open above their button and hide while open
N3-S2R23-tooltips.custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in with the "Admin" role at location "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919" (on another site: the location named in the test run).
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide with the zoom at 100%.
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST N3 Tooltips" has an Approved work order, unit "N3-U1", led by technician "ZZAUTOTEST N3 Tia".
  • Starting screen: "Work Orders" > "All" tab, "Tech View" shown, "Search" holding "ZZAUTOTEST N3 Tooltips", no filter chosen, "Assigned to me" off.
  • If any record named above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
N3-S2R23-tooltips.custom_steps:
1. Hover the density button.
  2. Click the density button.
  3. Press Escape.
  4. Hover the "Column Selection" button.
  5. Click the "Column Selection" button.
  6. Press Escape.
  7. Hover the "Tech View" button in the display switcher.
N3-S2R23-tooltips.custom_expected:
Step 1: the density button's tooltip opens above the button and does not cover the table's column header row.

Step 2: the density menu opens and no tooltip shows while it is open.

Step 3: the menu closes.

Step 4: the "Column Selection" button's tooltip opens above the button.

Step 5: the column menu opens and no tooltip shows while it is open.

Step 6: the menu closes.

Step 7: the switcher's tooltip opens above it too, the same way as the two buttons' tooltips.

N4-S2R23-name-bubbles.title: Row and card name bubbles open above the avatar, headers keep the plain tip
N4-S2R23-name-bubbles.custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in with the "Admin" role at location "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919" (on another site: the location named in the test run).
  • Six technicians are active at this location: "ZZAUTOTEST N4 Ana", "… Ben", "… Cal", "… Dee", "… Eve" and "… Fay" (each name starts "ZZAUTOTEST N4").
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST N4 Name Bubbles" has an Approved work order, unit "N4-U1", led by "ZZAUTOTEST N4 Ana", with five approved lines whose technicians are "… Ben", "… Cal", "… Dee", "… Eve" and "… Fay", so its avatars end in "+N".
  • Board View's "Fields to display" has "Line technicians" on. Starting screen: "Work Orders" > "All" tab, "Tech View" shown, "Search" holding "ZZAUTOTEST N4 Name Bubbles", no filter chosen, "Assigned to me" off, browser window at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record named above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
N4-S2R23-name-bubbles.custom_steps:
1. Hover the first avatar in the "Assigned Techs" cell of the row for unit "N4-U1".
  2. Hover the "+N" at the end of that cell.
  3. Hover the avatar in "ZZAUTOTEST N4 Ana"'s group header.
  4. Click "Board View" in the display switcher.
  5. Hover the first technician avatar on the card for unit "N4-U1".
  6. Hover the "+N" on that card.
  7. Hover the avatar in "ZZAUTOTEST N4 Ana"'s column header.
N4-S2R23-name-bubbles.custom_expected:
Step 1: a name bubble reading "ZZAUTOTEST N4 Ana" opens above the avatar.

Step 2: a name bubble listing the remaining names opens above the "+N".

Step 3: the browser's plain name tip shows "ZZAUTOTEST N4 Ana", not the bubble.

Step 4: Board View shows the card for unit "N4-U1" with its technician avatars.

Step 5: a name bubble reading "ZZAUTOTEST N4 Ana" opens above the avatar.

Step 6: a name bubble listing the remaining names opens above the "+N".

Step 7: the browser's plain name tip shows "ZZAUTOTEST N4 Ana", not the bubble.
